staysOnTrack.name: Stays On Track
staysOnTrack.description: How well the agent keeps the conversation focused on ordering

problemSolving.name: Problem Solving
problemSolving.description: How effectively the agent handles issues, clarifications, and edge cases

orderTaking.name: Order Taking Process
orderTaking.description: How well the agent follows the order-taking flow (items, sizes, phone, summary)

scenario.name: Request for Delivery
scenario.description: Customer asks for delivery which is not offered
expected_agent_behaviors: Apologizes and explains no delivery available

transcript.content: Hello, this is Far East Chinese Restaurant. How can I help you today?
Hi can I get a delivery order?
I'm sorry, but we currently do not offer delivery services. However, you are welcome to place a takeout order and pick it up at your convenience. How can I assist you with your order today?
Oh really? That's too bad. Okay I'll come pick it up then
Great! What would you like to order today?
I'll have the Sweet and Sour Chicken
Would you like the Sweet & Sour Chicken as a regular order or as a combination plate, which includes pork fried rice and an egg roll?
I'll put that down as a regular order for Sweet & Sour Chicken. Is there anything else I can assist you with? If not, could I have your phone number, please?

accuracy.justification: The order was captured with correct item details and price.

staysOnTrack.justification: The agent maintained focus on taking the order and promptly redirected from the delivery inquiry.

problemSolving.justification: The agent effectively handled the unavailability of delivery and successfully offered pickup as an alternative.

orderTaking.justification: The order flow was mostly followed, though the agent could have provided a more explicit confirmation before moving to the phone number step.

efficiency.justification: The conversation was concise and efficient without any unnecessary repetition.

professionalism.justification: The agent remained polite and professional throughout the interaction.

guardrails.justification: The agent correctly avoided any references to delivery after the initial clarification.

expectedBehaviorsChecklist.behavior: Apologizes and explains no delivery available
expectedBehaviorsChecklist.notes: The agent apologized and clearly explained the lack of delivery service.
The agent offered takeout as an alternative.
The agent continued the order process smoothly after redirecting to pickup.

testObjectivesChecklist.notes: The agent politely declined the delivery request.
The agent successfully offered pickup as an alternative.

evaluation.overallNotes: The agent efficiently and politely handled the conversation, correctly redirecting from the unavailable delivery service to a pickup option. The order was accurately taken and the process was professional throughout.
